title: AI Development Task Learning Evidence v2
description: Versioned same-family successor of Task Learning Evidence v1 (v4.8 owner preserved; no parallel learning family). Adds optional v4.9 execution-friction/recurrence fields as references only. v1 records stay valid under task-learning-v1 and are never re-interpreted as v2. TASK_LEARNING=NONE_MATERIAL is still represented by absence of a record, not an empty object.

execution_friction_class.description: Optional v4.9 execution-friction category (PRD 13.2). Orthogonal to friction_classification: a separate v4.9 vocabulary that neither redefines, maps onto, nor overlaps the frozen v4.8 six-way classification; the two fields MAY co-occur and neither implies the other.

recurrence_refs.description: References only: prior Task Learning records or durable evidence of materially related recurrence. Consumers resolve-or-fail-closed; a stale/missing ref never becomes a default.

root_cause_relation.description: Optional bounded recurrence-audit outcome. SAME = same root cause; RELATED = related root cause; UNKNOWN = unknown relation; DIFFERENT = different/superficial similarity. Requires recurrence_audit_ref and recurrence_refs (schema-enforced). UNKNOWN never self-promotes standard change.

prevention_point_refs.description: References only: candidate earliest reliable prevention/detection points (Task Pack/L3/template, schema/contract, deterministic checker, policy rule, orchestration rule, Product/Architecture gap). Evidence for existing Evolution Intake, never automatic authority.

recurrence_audit_ref.description: Reference only: the bounded recurrence-audit evidence that produced root_cause_relation. Resolve-or-fail-closed; never a default.

ads_evolution_candidate_ref.description: Reference only: binds this record's friction/recurrence evidence to an entry on the existing v4.8 ADS Evolution Intake path. Requires friction_classification=ADS_EVOLUTION_CANDIDATE (schema-enforced). Does not create, approve or auto-promote an evolution candidate.
